noise.description: Vast, undulating plains of solidified cosmic dust, occasionally broken by towering, crystalline memory fragments that shimmer with faint, internal light, forming subtle pathways and junctions.

shader.description: A deep, inky void subtly illuminated by countless distant, shimmering memory particles, occasionally coalescing into faint, swirling nebulae of forgotten stories. A sense of immense, echoing emptiness with a melancholic glow.

audio.ambience: A vast, echoing silence permeated by the deep, low hum of the cosmic void, carrying faint, almost imperceptible whispers and the distant, soft 'sigh' of forgotten epochs.
audio.description: The soundscape of The Genesis Nexus is dominated by an overwhelming sense of ancient, melancholic emptiness. Deep, sustained hums and drones from the cosmic void form the foundation, occasionally pierced by the ethereal shimmer of memory shards materializing or dissipating. Whispers of untold stories drift on the edge of hearing, while distant, slow pulses resonate through the silent expanse, evoking both profound sorrow and irresistible curiosity.
